an9.25:1.1: “Monks, when a monk’s mind is well shored-up by discernment, it is suitable for him to say,
an9.25:1.2: ‘Birth is ended, the holy life fulfilled, the task done. There is nothing further for this world.’
an9.25:2.1: And how is a monk’s mind well shored-up by discernment?
an9.25:2.2: “‘My mind is devoid of passion’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.3: “‘My mind is devoid of aversion’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.4: “‘My mind is devoid of delusion’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.5: “‘My mind isn’t subject to being impassioned’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.6: “‘My mind isn’t subject to being aversive’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.7: “‘My mind isn’t subject to being deluded’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.8: “‘My mind isn’t subject to returning for the sake of passion for sensuality’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.9: “‘My mind isn’t subject to returning for the sake of passion for form’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.10: “‘My mind isn’t subject to returning for the sake of passion for the formless’: His mind is well shored-up by discernment.
an9.25:2.11: “Monks, when a monk’s mind is well shored-up by discernment, it is suitable for him to say,
an9.25:2.12: ‘Birth is ended, the holy life fulfilled, the task done. There is nothing further for this world.’”
